title: Ninety-One Degrees
summary: On Day eight, Dev checks the boy's wrist and finds something that should not be there.

beats.text: Day eight. The boy would not sleep. He watched the elevator.
Dev took him to the first-aid room to check the wrist.
No bite. No fever. Dev held the thermometer up anyway, and frowned.
It read thirty-one degrees. Even the glass was warmer.
"Kid," Dev said softly. "How long have you been this cold?"
beats.speaker: dev

beats.text: "Since the bridge," the boy said. "Ruth told me I would warm up when you came."
Dev peeled the bandage. No wound. Just a number inked there: forty-one.
Across the gap, Calder Tower flashed it back. Forty-one. Forty-one.
Then the elevator woke. Thirty. Thirty-one. Climbing all by itself.
The boy smiled for the first time. "That's my ride," he said.
